instruction: A clean, realistic photographic medium full shot of a bright ballet studio with wooden barres. Five children stand in a diagonal line along the barre. From left to right: the girl with light brown hair (R2), the red-haired girl in a bun (R3), the boy with short brown hair (R4), the blonde girl in a bun (R1), and the red-haired boy (R5). The girls wear pink leotards with skirts and white tights, and the boys wear dark blue t-shirts with black shorts. The girl with light brown hair, the red-haired girl, and the boy with short brown hair extend their left legs forward in unison. The blonde girl stands straight, and the red-haired boy stands straight while looking down. Bright, even, soft indoor lighting illuminates the scene.
elements: R2, R3, and R4 extend their left legs forward in unison
R1 stands straight instead of doing the left-leg extension
